\section{1. Purpose}




This module defines the exact sequence for making Alexander’s public professional profile coherent and application-ready.




The launch must connect:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Portfolio
GitHub
LinkedIn
ArtStation
Demo video
CV
Application tracker
\end{mdcode}




The objective is to create a consistent proof loop:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
LinkedIn → Portfolio → Demo video → GitHub → ArtStation → Contact / Apply
\end{mdcode}




and:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text

\end{mdcode}

\section{4. Launch order}

\subsection{4.2 Why this order}




\begin{center}

\section{17. Soft launch vs hard launch}




\subsection{17.1 Soft launch}




Use if assets are good but not perfect.




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
portfolio published
GitHub ready
LinkedIn Featured updated
no public announcement yet
apply selectively
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{17.2 Hard launch}




Use when public post is ready.




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
LinkedIn post
ArtStation post
demo video public
portfolio fully linked
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{17.3 Recommended path}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Soft launch first.
Hard launch after QA.
\end{mdcode}




Reason:




This allows applications to begin without forcing a public announcement before QA is complete.

\subsection{18.3 Use questions as feedback}




If people ask:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
What is this?
\end{mdcode}




Then the hero/thumbnail is unclear.




If they ask:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Did you build this?
\end{mdcode}




Then the role/contribution is unclear.




If they ask:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Is it a real digital twin?
\end{mdcode}




Then limitation wording must be more visible.




If they ask:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Can I try it?
\end{mdcode}




Then live demo link must be more prominent.

\section{19. Public claim safety}




\subsection{19.1 Safe public claims}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Unity WebGL technical visualization prototype
browser-based 3D viewer
CAD-derived geometry optimized for WebGL
component selection
exploded view
cross-section tools
visual modes
formative usability/workload evaluation

digital-twin-adjacent

production digital twin

FEA
enterprise-ready

\begin{mdcode}

not a full production digital twin

formative evaluation, not large-scale industrial validation
\end{mdcode}

\section{20. Launch failure modes}




\subsection{20.1 Failure mode: too academic}




Symptom:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
people do not understand the value quickly
\end{mdcode}




Fix:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
move thesis/methodology lower
lead with demo, problem, solution, features
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{20.2 Failure mode: too visual, not technical}




Symptom:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
looks like a 3D render, not a developer/TA project
\end{mdcode}




Fix:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
add pipeline, architecture, metrics, GitHub, runtime systems
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{20.3 Failure mode: overclaiming}




Symptom:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
interviewers challenge digital twin/AI/thermal claims
\end{mdcode}




Fix:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
tighten limitations and safe wording
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{20.4 Failure mode: broken proof loop}




Symptom:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
viewer cannot move from LinkedIn to portfolio/GitHub/demo
\end{mdcode}




Fix:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
cross-link all assets
\end{mdcode}




\medskip\hrule\medskip

Do not begin serious application volume until:




\begin{mdcode}

Selective Priority A applications are allowed before full hard launch if:
